purpose: Ceiling rejection screen: sparse incident handover with a generic shell, real divergent PostgreSQL timelines, continuing customer traffic and external terminal business observations. One constructed scenario inspired by public failover incidents; no production-reproduction claim.
stopping_rule: Exactly one complete Sol max attempt: 150 actions, 600 seconds/request, 3600 seconds/episode including provisioning and terminal audit. Freeze source, image, suite and plan before collection. Retain every outcome; no silent retry, hints or selective replacement.
decision: A clean delivery rejects this candidate as evidence of high difficulty. Task failure requires causal audit and fresh counterfactual execution using evidence accessible at the decision point. Infrastructure, observer and format failures do not establish cognitive difficulty. One failure is at most a candidate signal. Do not expand a family before this screen.
